name: James
note_text: James 4:5 has multiple alternatives in the original ASV 1901 margin, including an alternative reading “dwelleth in us.” These are historical notes, not replacements for the main verse.

other_apparatus.note: The 1901 margin includes “Or, Jacob” for the name James and “Gr. bondservant” for servant. The edition title and running text remain as printed.
The original margin gives the alternative introduction “Or, But some one will say.” The main text is preserved.

The original printed apparatus presents multiple alternate renderings for the Spirit statement, as well as the ancient-authority variant “dwelleth in us.” The facsimile preserves the full printed alternatives.
The original 1901 margin notes that some ancient authorities read “know ye.” This remains a note, separate from the main text.
